notes: Engine exposes Prometheus metrics (DELONIX_MGMT_METRICS_ADDR) and CRI container stats; cAdvisor names are partial (container_memory_working_set_bytes present, container_cpu_usage_seconds_total missing). No dashboard-ingestion interop test yet, and ListContainerStats/ListPodSandboxMetrics completeness unverified.
OTLP present in delonix-telemetry. No OpenTelemetry Collector ingestion test; engine-operation spans (pull/build/run/vm create) and container.*/k8s.* semantic conventions not verified.
Direct OTLP reception by Jaeger not exercised.
CRI log format /var/log/containers is written. Fluent Bit collection of Delonix logs not tested in either mode.
Standalone log drivers (journald, otlp, fluentd-forward) not proven. The lab _labs/logging uses Vector -> 3 sinks; no fluentd-forward interop test.
